text: Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: confirmed current, retain P1. DenseFmriFitResult retains coefficients, selected timepoints/voxels, variance, optional AR diagnostics and preparation provenance but no fit-bound observed/fitted/residual trace result. Gls.residualMatrix remains private[fit]; exposing it alone would not satisfy the identity and transform contract. FirstLevelEstimates intentionally retains only requested outputs, including nuisance coefficients only when selected, so arbitrary historical estimate-only results cannot reconstruct the complete fitted signal without additional verified execution state. Refine implementation into explicit supported/refused diagnostic requests: retain or replay the exact bounded fit operator and required nuisance state under verified source/model identity, distinguishing original versus transformed residuals and never silently refitting. Existing discovery/scenario receipts are not evidence that this new public API exists. Keep all original numerical, censor-gap, AR-scope, cancellation and budget requirements; no full-volume residual retention by default. Source inspection only in this assessment.
